question: Does bootstrapping improved subsequent observed choices and fitting an advantage-weighted actor improve whole-run decisions beyond cloning the same historical routes?

references.adaptation: Independent PyTorch discrete-menu implementation, not upstream benchmark reproduction.

distinction: E144 lambda backups evaluate the recorded parent next action and deploy greedy Q over all supported legal actions. E128 optimizes two choices jointly with other future choices fixed. E154 uses all observed consecutive noncombat transitions, an upper-expectile V, Q backups through V, and a categorical actor fitted on recorded moves. Deployment never maximizes a critic over unlabelled menu actions.
critic: Two independent5339-to128-to64-to1 SiLU critics and one state/menu value network with candidate columns zero. All use sigmoid Heart-probability output initialized.1. V minimizes tau=.7 asymmetric squared error against min delayed Q1/Q2 at the recorded action. Q fits reward+(not done)*new V(next state), gamma1. Two optimizers per update, delayed Q weight EMA.005. Fixed20000 critic updates per excluding-family fold; no critic duration/parameter grid or actor feedback into fitting.
actor: Same691841-parameter public-input128/64 SiLU residual for both arms. Zero head and fixed+3 bonus on the exact frozen parent recommendation preserve initial deployed choices including its heuristic and first-boss wrapper. Cloning uses weight1; IQL uses min(100,exp(10*(min delayed Q-V))). Both minimize full-menu categorical negative log likelihood of actual recorded actions. No winning-route filtering, floor/HP reward, off-dataset critic maximization, or hand-written item values.
sampling: Uniform fit family; uniform available stratum (multiple recorded actions, remaining terminal states, remaining ordinary states); uniform state in stratum; uniform recorded outgoing action. Identical uniform draws for actor arms. Deduplicated graph edges are sampled once; raw occurrence counts are provenance only. Singleton menus remain for credit propagation.
roles: Original1536 fit families, original E73 SHA256 modulo3 outer folds. Complete descendants follow family. Each critic sees outer-fitting families only. Each actor uses the E151-inner SHA rule to separate about20% of these families for stopping. Critic remains frozen and includes those inner actor-validation families; this is actor validation, not a separately held critic test. Outer family is excluded from both.
stopping: For each actor arm, deterministic8192 draws from inner actor-validation families produce its fixed validation set. Minimize the same weighted negative log likelihood at0,25,50,100,250,500,1000,2000, ties earliest. Save all checkpoints. Reinitialize actor and refit all outer-fitting families for the chosen duration using the same frozen critic. Outer natural results never choose training length.
support: Only categorical action identities recorded as chosen in outer-fit families may replace the frozen parent; the parent is always allowed. Training and deployment apply the same full-menu mask. No seed/RNG/state fingerprint/raw source/terminal metadata in model features.

whole_run_screen.selection: Same fixed E144-full-run hash-selected original fit pilot, each using its excluding-fold model; historical development evidence, not final unseen acceptance.
whole_run_screen.verification: Full natural A20 Heart games, every terminal/state/RNG and neural choice audited; all winners rerun with fresh NN/MCTS. Both arms retain all128 assigned families. Evaluation trajectories are not training input.

iql_specific_comparison: Report paired IQL-minus-cloning. Claim an IQL-specific gain only with net>=4/128 and p<.05. Separately, either arm can qualify against parent under the two-arm gate. Neither gate proves50%.
continuation: Only a qualified arm may proceed to separately registered all1536-fit learning and the reserved512 natural-development families; require net>=20/512,p<.05 and complete fault/state/RNG checks. Select among qualified arms by net gain, fewer parent wins lost, then cloning. No automatic adoption or fresh acceptance. Final goal one frozen policy>=512/1024 untouched families.
resource_limits: Eight single-thread natural evaluation workers. MCTS8000, bossx3, native max replans256;300s episode and360s process guard unchanged. Four-hour training and seven-hour evaluation ceilings are guards, not duration estimates.
limits: No new training sampling. Prismatic Shard and simulator-original parity excluded. Prior E128/E144/E148-E152 failures remain recorded; this is a changed control objective and deployed actor, not another fixed-parent terminal-ranking grid.
